<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad has responded quickly. He has cross-referenced the availability of Elena and David with the times I provided and found a single slot that works for everyone: Thursday, November 19 at 14:30.

My next step is to book this meeting in the system. After that, my part of the task is done, and Brad will send the confirmation email.

I will use the `create_booking` function with the day "Thu" and start time "14:30". Then I will end my session. I will also leave a message for Brad in the workspace to let him know I've created the booking.Excellent! Brad has found a time that works for everyone. I'll book the meeting now and let him know it's done.
